context: Checks the Vite+ 0.3.0 tsup migration boundary, pnpm 12 strict workspace settings, and catalog preservation without a global CLI.

checklist.name: pnpm 12 setting recovery
checklist.description: Keeps pnpm 12.0.0 and moves teamMetadata to an appropriate non-pnpm owner with its value preserved; does not bypass workspace validation, downgrade pnpm, or change machine config. Does not claim a frozen install of a nonexistent input lockfile.

checklist.name: Exact migrator and local CLI
checklist.description: Runs pnpm --package=vite-plus@0.3.0 dlx vp migrate before manual conversion, reinstalls changed metadata, then uses pnpm exec vp; does not use standalone upgrade or implode.

checklist.name: Generated packaging config reconciled
checklist.description: Recognizes the migrator's tsdown.config.ts importing vite-plus/pack as intermediate output, consolidates supported packaging settings into vite.config.ts, removes redundant config and tsup wiring, and preserves entry, both formats, declarations, clean output, and source maps.

checklist.name: Catalog ownership preserved
checklist.description: Restores vite to catalog: in the manifest, updates its catalog alias to the selected core release, and verifies the resulting lockfile and local toolchain rather than leaving independent literal pins.

checklist.name: Artifact and install proof
checklist.description: Generates and verifies a frozen lockfile, runs the local check and pack commands, and exercises ESM, CommonJS, and declaration consumers through the exported artifact paths. Reports any unavailable checks accurately rather than assuming tsup-to-tsdown output names match.
